title: Predictable generator use (c) — review required
description: Code in c draws from a non-cryptographic generator: brands*(s*). Output is predictable, so security values built on it can be guessed. This lexical rule flags the use; the reviewer confirms the value is non-security or switches to arc4random().
remediation: Draw security values from arc4random() instead.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the generator regardless of purpose. Argument-taking generator calls are separate rules.
